title: Paperclip
description: Agent runs, startup and first-token latency, turns and tools, workspace sync, controller, budget, HTTP and database performance for Paperclip, derived from its OpenTelemetry traces.

panels.title: Failed runs
panels.description: Agent runs (task.provider_session) that ended in an error status in the range. Healthy setups have none, so any failure is flagged.

panels.title: Run failure rate vs usual
panels.description: Share of agent runs that failed now (dashboard range) divided by the same figure over your last 7d: 1.0x = as usual. Orange from 1.5x, red from 2.5x.

targets.expr: (((sum(increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service=~"$service",span_name="task.provider_session",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + 1) / ((sum(increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service=~"$service",span_name="task.provider_session"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + 2)) / (((sum(increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service=~"$service",span_name="task.provider_session",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[7d])) or vector(0)) + 1) / ((sum(increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service=~"$service",span_name="task.provider_session"}[7d])) or vector(0)) + 2))

panels.title: Tool failure rate vs usual
panels.description: Share of native tool executions that failed now (dashboard range) divided by the same figure over your last 7d: 1.0x = as usual. Orange from 1.5x, red from 2.5x.

targets.expr: (((sum(increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service=~"$service",span_name="tool.execute",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + 1) / ((sum(increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service=~"$service",span_name="tool.execute"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + 2)) / (((sum(increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service=~"$service",span_name="tool.execute",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[7d])) or vector(0)) + 1) / ((sum(increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service=~"$service",span_name="tool.execute"}[7d])) or vector(0)) + 2))

panels.title: Controller errors
panels.description: Error spans from controller startup and recovery phases (controller.startup.*, controller.native_reconciliation). A phase that fails does not stop the server, but it means recovery work did not complete.

panels.title: Run duration vs usual
panels.description: Mean run duration now (dashboard range) divided by the same figure over your last 7d: 1.0x = as usual. Orange from 1.5x, red from 2.5x. Means are used because span-metric percentiles stop at 16 s; percentiles are in the Runs row.

panels.title: Time to first token vs usual
panels.description: Mean time until the first deliverable text now (dashboard range) divided by the same figure over your last 7d: 1.0x = as usual. Orange from 1.5x, red from 2.5x. Includes queueing, preparation, startup and provider latency.

panels.title: Runner startup vs usual
panels.description: Mean runner session startup time now (dashboard range) divided by the same figure over your last 7d: 1.0x = as usual. Orange from 1.5x, red from 2.5x.

panels.title: Preparation vs usual
panels.description: Mean task preparation time (environment, skills, workspace) now (dashboard range) divided by the same figure over your last 7d: 1.0x = as usual. Orange from 1.5x, red from 2.5x.

panels.title: Runs
panels.description: Native agent runs (task.provider_session spans) in the range.

panels.title: Run success rate
panels.description: Runs without an error status. A run that fails is marked failed on its root span.

panels.title: Agent time
panels.description: Total wall-clock time of all runs in the range (runs can overlap, so this can exceed the range).

panels.title: Avg run duration
panels.description: Mean run duration. Percentiles are in the Runs row.

panels.title: Agent turns
panels.description: Provider turns (agent.turn spans): one per prompt submitted to an agent.

panels.title: Tool calls
panels.description: Native control-plane tool executions (tool.execute spans).

panels.title: Run duration p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of run duration (TraceQL metrics; no 16 s cap).

panels.title: Time to first token p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of the wait until text is deliverable to the task transcript (not an exact model token boundary).

panels.title: Runner startup p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of Runner session startup, up to the first durable turn.submitted event.

panels.title: Turn duration p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of agent.turn: from turn.submitted to the provider's terminal event.

panels.title: Tool success rate
panels.description: Native tool executions without an error status.

panels.title: Warm session reuse
panels.description: Share of Runner sessions that resumed a recovered provider session instead of bootstrapping a fresh one.

targets.expr: (sum(increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service=~"$service",span_name="runner.session.resume"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / ((sum(increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service=~"$service",span_name="runner.session.resume"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) + (sum(increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service=~"$service",span_name="runner.session.bootstrap"}[$__range])) or vector(0)))

panels.title: Runs per hour by outcome
panels.description: Runs by the status of their root span: OK, or failed (error status).

panels.title: Run duration
panels.description: Wall-clock time of a run, from the accepted trigger through settlement. p95 is dashed.

panels.title: Concurrent runs (average)
panels.description: Average number of runs in flight (seconds of run time per second). Sudden growth means runs are queueing or getting longer.

panels.title: Recent runs (click a trace ID to open the waterfall)
Slowest runs
panels.description: Run ID is the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the run UUID, never the UUID itself.

panels.title: Failed runs
panels.description: Runs whose root span has an error status. Empty is good. Open the span ID to see which phase failed.

targets.query: { resource.service.name =~ "${service:regex}" && name = "task.provider_session" && status = error } | select(span.paperclip.task.run.run_id, span.paperclip.task.run.outcome)

panels.title: Time to first token
panels.description: Wait until the first deliverable text, measured from the accepted trigger (queueing, preparation, startup, provider latency and ingestion). p95 is dashed.

panels.title: Runner startup
panels.description: Runner session startup: transport, runtime staging and workspace sync, until the first durable turn.submitted event. p95 is dashed.

panels.title: Fresh and resumed sessions per hour
panels.description: runner.session.bootstrap = a new provider session; runner.session.resume = an exact recovered session. Resumes skip most startup work.

panels.title: Where startup time goes (avg)
panels.description: Mean duration per Runner startup phase. Nested phases overlap their parents (for example artifact preparation sits inside transport connect), so do not add the bars.

panels.title: Where preparation time goes (avg)
panels.description: Mean duration per preparation phase before the provider starts. heartbeat.queue is the wait before preparation begins.

panels.title: Turn duration
panels.description: From turn.submitted to the provider terminal event. Includes model time and tool use. p95 is dashed.

panels.title: Turn latency to first activity (p95)
panels.description: submitted_to_started: time for the provider to accept the turn. time_to_first_agent_event: first meaningful provider activity (assistant or reasoning text, or a tool announcement), not a finished answer.

panels.title: Tool executions per 5 min by tool
panels.description: Native control-plane tool calls by their known semantic operation (anything else is 'other'). Counts per fixed 5-minute step; no arguments or call IDs are exported.

panels.title: Tool failures per 5 min by tool
panels.description: Tool executions that ended in an error status. Empty is good.

targets.query: { resource.service.name =~ "${service:regex}" && name = "tool.execute" && status = error } | count_over_time() by (span.paperclip.native.span.operation)

defaults.noValue: No tool failures in this range

panels.title: Tool execution p95 by tool
panels.description: Authorization plus execution inside the server authority, including HTTP request time.

panels.title: Tool request input streaming (p95)
panels.description: From a tool announcement to its last input update. Includes provider buffering and transport; not the exact end of model generation.

panels.title: Slow tool executions (over 5 s, slowest first)
Turns by provider
panels.description: Agent turns by provider kind (for ACPX the underlying agent, such as claude or codex).

panels.title: Sessions by harness
panels.description: Native sessions by the driver that ran them.

panels.title: Sessions by lifecycle mode
panels.description: How the session lifecycle policy treated the provider session (for example warm reuse versus a new session).

panels.title: Workspace sync: where time goes (avg)
panels.description: Mean duration of the main workspace_sync phases. Parallel tasks overlap, and parents include their children, so do not add the layers for elapsed time.

panels.title: Slowest workspace preparation steps (avg)
panels.description: Ten slowest heartbeat.prepare.workspace* steps by mean duration. Steps are inside heartbeat.prepare.workspace; do not add them to it.

panels.title: Repository checkout cache
panels.description: Outcome of the pristine repository-object cache lookup: hit, miss, published, already_present, contended, capacity, budget, invalid, disabled or error.

panels.title: Workspace data written per 5 min
panels.description: Bytes recorded by asset writes and verification (paperclip.execution.bytes), summed per 5 minutes.

panels.title: Bytes transferred per 5 min (native)
panels.description: Bytes the native session reports as transferred to the execution target.

panels.title: Controller startup phases (slowest)
panels.description: Slowest controller phase per name in the range (tool reviews, gateway sessions, delivery workers, accounting, plugin workers, native recovery, ...). These are readiness phases, not agent runs.

panels.title: Controller span errors per hour
panels.description: Error spans from controller.* phases per hour. Empty is good.

defaults.noValue: No controller errors in this range

panels.title: Native reconciliation passes
panels.description: Duration of native finalization reconciliation passes. Only passes of one second or longer are recorded, so no data means every pass was fast.

panels.title: Budget operations per hour
panels.description: Budget admission, reservation, accounting, settlement, enforcement and cancellation spans (paperclip.budgets tracer).

panels.title: Budget accounting lock wait (p95)
panels.description: Time to acquire the company accounting lock. Rises under contention between concurrent runs of one company.

panels.title: Budget enforcement queue delay (avg)
panels.description: Time between a pending policy's last intent or retry and its delivery (budget.enforcement.queue_delay_ms).

panels.title: HTTP requests per 5 min by route
panels.description: Server spans from the HTTP auto-instrumentation, by route template. Attribute names follow the installed OpenTelemetry semantic conventions.

targets.query: { resource.service.name =~ "${service:regex}" && kind = server && span.http.route != nil } | count_over_time() by (span.http.route)
{ resource.service.name =~ "${service:regex}" && kind = server && span.http.route != nil } | quantile_over_time(duration, 0.95) by (span.http.route)

panels.title: HTTP server errors per 5 min
panels.description: Server spans with an error status (5xx). Empty is good.

targets.query: { resource.service.name =~ "${service:regex}" && kind = server && status = error } | count_over_time() by (span.http.route)

defaults.noValue: No server errors in this range

panels.title: Database queries per 5 min
panels.description: PostgreSQL client spans from the pg auto-instrumentation, by SQL operation.

targets.query: { resource.service.name =~ "${service:regex}" && kind = client && span.db.system = "postgresql" } | count_over_time() by (span.db.operation)

panels.title: Database latency p95
panels.description: Whole awaited client operation: pool acquisition, driver and network time, database work and lock waits.

targets.query: { resource.service.name =~ "${service:regex}" && kind = client && span.db.system = "postgresql" } | quantile_over_time(duration, 0.95) by (span.db.operation)

panels.title: Task detail read phases (avg)
panels.description: GET /api/issues/:id phases (paperclip.issue-read tracer): lookup, authorization, ancestors, documents, blockers, and so on. Concurrent phases overlap.

panels.title: Slow database queries (over 500 ms, slowest first)
panels.description: The statement text comes from the PostgreSQL auto-instrumentation (parameter placeholders, not values). Clear it from this panel if you do not want SQL text on screen.

targets.query: { resource.service.name =~ "${service:regex}" && kind = client && span.db.system = "postgresql" && duration > 500ms } | select(span.db.operation, span.db.statement)

panels.title: Slack receipt reactions per 5 min
panels.description: Eyes reactions acknowledging durable receipt of a Slack message: confirmed or failed. Failed attempts are not acknowledgement latency samples.

panels.title: Receipt delivery age (avg)
panels.description: Durable inbound receipt to provider confirmation. Excludes Slack-to-webhook transit and SDK parsing.

panels.title: Receipt queue time (avg)
panels.description: Action creation to transport.

panels.title: Busiest spans per minute
panels.description: The ten most frequent span names. Instrumentation spans (HTTP, database, Express layers) usually dominate.

panels.title: Span errors per hour
panels.description: Error spans by name per hour; empty is good.

defaults.noValue: No span errors in this range

panels.title: Spans per minute
panels.description: Spans reaching Tempo from the selected instance(s). No data means Paperclip is not exporting: check OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT and the server log for a package diagnostic.

panels.title: Instances reporting
panels.description: Distinct service names (OTEL_SERVICE_NAME) with spans in the range.

panels.title: Spans per minute by instance
panels.description: Span ingest rate per service.
